```{python}
import make_choropleth
import json
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px


make_choropleth.OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

raw = json.loads(make_choropleth.RAW_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
records = raw["records"]
geo = json.loads(make_choropleth.resolve_geojson_path().read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
features = geo["features"]

collection, rows, unmatched_geo, unmatched_tsje = make_choropleth.build_feature_collection(records, features)

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

make_choropleth.OUT_DIR.joinpath("distritos_intendentes_2026.geojson").write_text(
    json.dumps(collection, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"
)
```


```{python}
from shapely.geometry import shape, mapping

simplified_collection = {
    "type": "FeatureCollection",
    "features": []
}

for feature in collection["features"]:
    geom = shape(feature["geometry"])

    simplified_geom = geom.simplify(
        tolerance=0.001,
        preserve_topology=True
    )

    simplified_collection["features"].append({
        "type": "Feature",
        "geometry": mapping(simplified_geom),
        "properties": feature["properties"],
    })
```


```{python}
fig = px.choropleth(
    df,
    geojson=simplified_collection,
    locations="distrito",
    featureidkey="properties.DIST_DESC_",
    color="partido",
    color_discrete_map={
        row["partido"]: row["color_hex"] for _, row in df.iterrows()
    },
    custom_data=[
        "distrito",
        "departamento",
        "votos",
        "candidato",
        "partido",
        "pct",
    ],
)

fig.update_traces(
    hovertemplate=(
        "<b>%{customdata[0]}</b><br>"
        "Departamento: %{customdata[1]}<br>"
        "Votos: %{customdata[2]:,}<br>"
        "Ganador: %{customdata[3]}<br>"
        "de %{customdata[4]}<br>"
        "% votos: %{customdata[5]:.2f}%"
        "<extra></extra>"
    )
)

fig.update_geos(
    fitbounds="geojson",
    visible=False
)

fig.update_layout(
    title=dict(text="Intendentes ganadores 2026 - Paraguay", font=dict(size=50), automargin=True, yref='paper'),
    showlegend=False,
    autosize=True,
    height=800
)

fig.show()
```

```{python}
import plotly.io as pio


pio.write_html(fig, file="output/mapa_intendentes_2026.html")
```
